peopleparser: Parse Raw Person Names into Structured Components

Source: R/peopleparser-package.R
peopleparser-package.Rd

Converts raw text names into structured components (salutation, first name, middle name, last name, suffix, and status) and infers gender using U.S. Census name-frequency data. Proper name ordering is disambiguated probabilistically based on how often each token appears in the first-name versus last-name position.
